description.fr-FR: Les cinquante-quatre poésies de Thérèse (PN 1–54), écrites de 1893 à 1897 pour les fêtes de la communauté, pour ses sœurs et pour ses frères spirituels, de « Vivre d’Amour ! » à « Pourquoi je t’aime, ô Marie ! », suivies des huit poésies supplémentaires (PS 1–8). Texte authentique de l’édition du Centenaire, d’après les archives du Carmel de Lisieux.
description.en-US: The fifty-four poems of Thérèse (PN 1–54), written between 1893 and 1897 for community feasts, for her sisters and for her spiritual brothers, from “Living on Love” to “Why I Love You, O Mary”, followed by the eight supplementary poems (PS 1–8). The authentic text of the Centenary edition, from the archives of the Carmel of Lisieux.
description.pt-BR: Os cinquenta e quatro poemas de Teresinha (PN 1–54), escritos de 1893 a 1897 para as festas da comunidade, para as irmãs e para os irmãos espirituais, de «Viver de Amor!» a «Por que te amo, ó Maria!», seguidos dos oito poemas suplementares (PS 1–8). Texto autêntico da edição do Centenário, segundo os arquivos do Carmelo de Lisieux.

fr-FR.editor: Carmel de Lisieux (Nouvelle Édition du Centenaire)

sources.edition: Archives du Carmel de Lisieux, one page per poem (/archive/pn-1/ … /archive/pn-54/, /archive/ps1/ … /archive/ps8/), read through the site's WordPress REST API (wp-json/wp/v2/archive). The Nouvelle Édition du Centenaire text, with the strophe numbers and the refrains as on the site.
sources.description: Thérèse's text only. The editors' apparatus is left out: the "Datation" and "Destinataire" notes under each poem, the links to the facsimiles and to a theology thesis on PN 17, the "Refr. N" cross-references before the refrains, and the "Synopse" pages, which set the 1898 retouched versions beside the authentic ones. Strophe numbers are normalised to bold. The 1898 retouched versions are not included.
sources.tierEvidence: Thérèse died in 1897; the poems were first published in 1979 (Poésies, Cerf), so the 25-year right in posthumous works (CPI art. L123-4) ended in 2004. The site states no terms (its mentions légales page is empty, checked 2026-11-01); the editors' datings and notes are not taken.
